description: Convert up to 50 KBLI 2020 business codes to KBLI 2025 in one call (official BPS conversion table, 2026), e.g. all codes of a company's OSS/NIB licence. Per code: status one_to_one, split, merged, not_found or invalid, the KBLI 2025 candidates, and needs_review with the reason; plus a summary. format=csv returns a spreadsheet. Charged only if at least one code converts. Costs $0.50 per call (x402, USDC on Base; see lokalapi_info).

codes.description: KBLI 2020 codes (5 digits), at most 50 unique, e.g. ['62019', '46900']

format.description: csv: one line per old -> new code pair (default json)

name: kbli_convert_batch
